title: DFECDR
text: Decision feedback equalizer (DFE) with clock and data recovery (CDR), 1 input, 1 output, {Mode} sets DFE operating mode; {Initial tap weights (V)} sets the initial DFE tap weights, {Adaptive gain} Controls DFE tap weight update, {Adaptive step size (V)} sets the dFE adaptive step, {Minimum DFE tap value (V)} sets the minimum value of adapted taps, {Maximum DFE tap value (V)} sets the maximum value of adapted taps, {2x tap weights} sets the multiply DFE tap weights by a factor, {CDR Mode} determines CDR, {Phase Detector} sets the clock phase detector, {Phase Offset (symbol time)} sets the clock phase offset, {Reference offset (ppm)} sets the reference clock offset impairment, {Early/late count threshold} sets the early or late CDR count threshold to trigger phase, {Step (symbol time)} sets the clock phase resolution, {Frequency tracking gain} sets the internal gain for frequency tracking, {Frequency tracking update}, {Frequency step ramp} sets the number of symbol times required for initial internal frequency tracking gain to reach specified, {Sensitivity (V)} sets the sampling latch metastability voltage, {Tap weights}, {Phase Offset} and {Reference offset}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Mode
params.values: DFE operating mode Adapt (default) | Off | Fixed

params.name: Initial tap weights (V)
params.values: Initial DFE tap weights [0 0 0 0] (default) | row vector

params.name: Adaptive gain
params.values: Controls DFE tap weight update rate 9.6e-5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Adaptive step size (V)
params.values: DFE adaptive step resolution 1e-06 (default) | nonnegative real scalar | nonnegative real-valued row vector

params.name: Minimum DFE tap value (V)
params.values: Minimum value of adapted taps -1 (default) | real scalar | real-valued row vector

params.name: Maximum DFE tap value (V)
params.values: Maximum value of adapted taps 1 (default) | nonnegative real scalar | nonnegative real-valued row vector

params.name: 2x tap weights
params.values: Multiply DFE tap weights by a factor of two off (default) | on

params.name: CDR Mode
params.values: Determine CDR order 1st order (default) | 2nd order

params.name: Phase Detector
params.values: Clock phase detector option BangBang (default) | BaudRateTypeA

params.name: Phase Offset (symbol time)
params.values: Clock phase offset 0 (default) | real scalar in the range [-0.5,0.5]

params.name: Reference offset (ppm)
params.values: Reference clock offset impairment 0 (default) | real scalar in the range [0, 300]

params.name: Early/late count threshold
params.values: Early or late CDR count threshold to trigger phase update 16 (default) | real positive integer ≥5

params.name: Step (symbol time)
params.values: Clock phase resolution 0.0078 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Frequency tracking gain
params.values: Internal gain for frequency tracking 0.00048828125 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Frequency tracking update
params.values: Frequency tracking update 16 (default) | nonnegative integer scalar

params.name: Frequency step ramp
params.values: Number of symbol times required for initial internal frequency tracking gain to reach specified value 3000 (default) | nonnegative integer scalar

params.name: Sensitivity (V)
params.values: Sampling latch metastability voltage 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Tap weights
params.values: Include Tap weights parameter in IBIS-AMI model on (default) | off

params.name: Phase Offset
params.values: Include Phase Offset parameter in IBIS-AMI model on (default) | off

params.name: Reference offset
params.values: Include Reference offset parameter in IBIS-AMI model on (default) | off
